goals.1: How to take medicine: dreimal täglich, vor/nach dem Essen
goals.2: Asking for medicine at the pharmacy
dialog.0.de.2.n: Was darf es sein? = What would you like? (the usual shop question)
grammar.0.note: Bitte makes it more polite: „Nehmen Sie bitte …“. In all three forms the verb comes first.
grammar.1.title: Irregular and separable imperatives
grammar.1.note: du-imperative of e→i verbs: nimm, sprich, lies, gib. The reflexive pronoun comes after the verb: „Setz dich!“, „Setzen Sie sich!“.
grammar.2.title: Rules for taking medicine
grammar.2.note: vor, nach + Dativ: vor dem Essen, nach dem Essen. sollen: „Sie sollen viel Wasser trinken“ = an instruction for you.
grammar.2.rows.0.1: once / twice / three times a day
grammar.2.rows.3.1: in the morning / at midday / at night
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “Drink plenty of water!”
